newsitem.title: USA: Touch Tone America names new president.
newsitem.headline: Touch Tone America names new president.

text.p: Touch Tone America Inc, which is seeking a merger candidate despite its problems, said Larry Cornwell was named interim president and to the board of directors in a shake-up of the company's board.
Cornwell, Dr. Edward Wirth Jr. and Robert Vaughan were appointed to the Touch Tone board of directors.
Cornwell replaces Michael Canney, who resigned after serving as Touch Tone's president for the past year.
Matt Barletta resigned as a director on April 17, 1997 and Robert Vaughan resigned as a director on June 6, 1997, Touch Tone said.
Bruce Walko remains as a director, the company said.

Conwell Consulting Services, a consulting firm that has signed an agreement with Touch Tone, has identified numerous problems that could jeopardize Touch Tone's existence, including lack of capital, several lawsuits in which Touch Tone is either the plaintiff or the defendant, unpaid payroll and withholding taxes, and unfulfilled carrier commitments.
These problems either individually and/or collectively are impossible for Touch Tone to meet without additional capital.
